description: A collection of files, according to some selection criteria. Mainly intended for GenomicAnnotationFile entities, but other types of files can also be contained in a collection, e.g. raw data files such as FASTQ files. This is the natural future home for the BEDset concept (a curated collection of BED files).

contact.description: Contact point for the parent object (e.g. the study, or the creator/maintainer of a file collection).

deposit_versioned_ref.description: Reference to versioned id of deposit containing this file collection.

filecollection_description.description: Human-readable description of the file collection.

filecollection_external_id.description: External, globally unique identifier for the file collection (in most cases, this will not exist).

filecollection_id.description: Internal identifier for the file collection (unique within the metadata deposit).

filecollection_input_sources.description: References to other input sources from which this file collection was derived.

filecollection_label.description: A human-readable description of the file collection, short enough to be used for listings within software user interfaces, tables, illustration legends, etc.

title: FileCollection
